questions.question: What did Solomon do over twenty years after building the temple and his palace?
From whom did Solomon conscript forced labor?
options: The Egyptians who had come and settled in Judah
The descendants of the surviving Canaanite peoples
The Phoenician traders of the cities of Tyre and Sidon
The Israelites who lived in the northern tribes
questions.answer: The descendants of the surviving Canaanite peoples

questions.question: Solomon kept the appointed feasts and offerings according to the command of Moses.
Solomon's ships, with Hiram's servants, went to _____ and brought back gold.
Solomon did not make any of the people of _____ slaves for his work; they were soldiers.
